cls: Please file a bug and associate it with this change.
Can call std::vector::reserve() since the size is easy to determine.

`GPU_FEATURE_TYPE_ACCELERATED_GL` isn't a great signal for anything. It's true for WARP fallback [here](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:gpu/config/gpu_util.cc;l=300;drc=d0723a…
GPU_FEATURE_TYPE_VULKAN is only marked blocklisted [here](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:gpu/config/gpu_util.cc;l=136;drc=d0723a0eb4eab943f34671d39eaa8f97be5780af) which…
GPU_FEATURE_TYPE_SKIA_GRAPHITE is similar to Vulkan. It's blocked from the GPU blocklist but also from potentially the Vulkan blocklist which caused the feature status to be disabled.
